titles.title: UnrealGold
titles.engine_and_build: Unreal Engine 1, Unreal Gold 226b (Unreal + Return to Na Pali/UPak). System\ renderers: D3DDrv.dll (DirectX 7, md5 f924e209, logs 'Unreal 1 Direct3D support - internal revision 1.7-UT'), GlideDrv.dll (md5 b0c91ce1) and OpenGlDrv.dll. The tree also ships a game-local nGlide glide2x.dll (1,310,720 B), which the launcher moves aside when FR_GLIDE=1.
titles.on_boxes: Deployed on .123 .124 .145 .195 .240 (DIRLIST C:\Games, 2026-09-29 03:53). .243: not deployed (gated: 604 MB free disk, needs 620). The shortcut 'Play Unreal Gold.bat' starts System\Unreal.exe; 'Host Unreal Gold LAN.bat' is a UCC dedicated server with no display. Renderer on .123/.145/.195/.240: D3DDrv (the FR_UE1DEV default). Unreal.log reads 'Bound to D3DDrv.dll' on .123 (HD 3850), .145 (8400GS) and .195 (HD 5450). Renderer on .124: GlideDrv, because HKLM\Software\RetroAgent GlideRender=1 plus VEN_121A silicon make FR_UE1DEV=GlideDrv, and the launcher moves nGlide aside. .124 Unreal.log (2026-09-28 12:36): 'Bound to GlideDrv.dll', 'Found Glide: 2.70 1.00.01.0106GXP'. That is the system32 GlideXP glide2x.dll (94,208 B), which translates to our h5 glide3x.dll (system32, 1,025,320 B).
titles.resolution_per_box: .123/.145/.195/.240: 1920x1080x32. The launcher (-ini FullscreenViewportX/Y from FR_W/FR_H) and the gameres.h rule both write it, and the ini reads 1920x1080 on all four. .124: 1024x768 under Glide. The launcher's UE1G2W/UE1G2H ladder turns FR_W43=1280 into 1024x768, and Unreal.log reads 'grSstOpen Res=0 Ref=12', where 12 = GR_RESOLUTION_1024x768. GlideDrv prints the refresh under 'Res' and the resolution under 'Ref'. .243: n/a.
titles.refresh_control: D3DDrv: none. It calls IDirectDraw7::SetDisplayMode(w,h,bpp,refresh=0,flags=0) (push 0/push 0 at 0x1000b2a4..0x1000b2c1), and no 'refresh' string exists in D3DDrv/OpenGlDrv, ASCII or UTF-16. OpenGlDrv: none (CDS dmFields 0x180000). GlideDrv: ini [GlideDrv.GlideRenderDevice] RefreshRate=<enum>. The UTF-16 enum names in GlideDrv.dll are 60Hz 70Hz 72Hz 75Hz 80Hz 85Hz 90Hz 100Hz 120Hz, and the dll logs 'Glide: Refresh %i failed, falling back...'. Under our h5 Glide, FX_GLIDE_REFRESH replaces whatever the game asks for: minihwc.c:4675 is unconditional, and hwcGetenv (minihwc.c:9547) reads the process environment before HKCU and HKLM.
titles.set_today: Nothing refresh-related. The launcher and gameres.h write only the viewport, StartupFullscreen and the render device, and FR_HZ is unused. The staged RefreshRate=60Hz reads back unchanged on all five boxes, and no launcher sets FX_GLIDE_REFRESH. On .124 the registry holds FX_GLIDE_REFRESH="75", an AmigaMerlin leftover at Services\3dfxvs\Device0\glide (v56k plan: this is the key our Glide reads). The same value sits at ...\Control\Video\{919B6B70-...}\0000\Glide (REGREAD today).
titles.best_per_box: .123/.145/.240: 1920x1080@60, the only rate listed at 1080p under EDID vmax 76. .195: 1920x1080@60 (every mode on this box is 60 only). .124: 1024x768@85 (GAMERES; HP P1120 EDID vmax 160). .243: n/a.
titles.expected_today_per_box: LCD boxes: 60, the only 1080p rate; not measured for this title. .124: 75, inferred and not measured for Unreal. Unreal asks for GR_REFRESH_60Hz ('Res=0'), and glide3x then substitutes the registry FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=75. The same substitution was measured today on .124 for Quake II, ioquake3, GLQuake and Half-Life: the ICD asked for 85, and the vcr-kmd log shows 'mode 199: 1280x960x32@75' with DISPLAYCFG reading 75 while running (static/124-measured-modeset-classes.txt).
titles.gap: .124: 75 Hz instead of 85. Deleting the registry value alone would make it worse: the ini asks for 60Hz, so the result would be 60. LCD boxes: no gap.
titles.fix:
In 'Play Unreal Gold.bat', inside the FR_UE1DEV=GlideDrv branch:
(1) Before start, add: if not defined FX_GLIDE_REFRESH set "FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=<best rate at UE1G2W x UE1G2H>". The process environment beats the HKLM value in hwcGetenv, so this is per launch and touches no 3dfx driver setting.
(2) Write [GlideDrv.GlideRenderDevice] RefreshRate=<the same rate, snapped down to the enum>Hz with FLEETRES -ini, mirrored by a GR_OP_INI rule. A Glide without the override, such as the Voodoo 2 kit, then asks for the right rate too.
This needs FLEETRES to publish a per-resolution best rate. Candidates are the mechanism lane's gr_target_hz tokens FR_HZ43/FR_HZW (phase 1, uncommitted), or a small '-besthz W H' query, because the Glide ladder mode (1024x768) is neither FR_W nor FR_W43. Where the value is 0, set nothing. LCD boxes need no change.
titles.fix_risk: Low on the hardware: vcr-kmd lists 85 at 1024x768, and the tube already runs its desktop at 1280x1024@85. If a rate is not in the table, h5 Glide falls back to the driver default (3dfxctl DEPLOY.md cites win_mode.c:297-350). Coordination risk: .124 belongs to the V5 6000 lane, and its harness pins FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=60 in the environment, which is why the 'if not defined' guard matters; changing the effective refresh changes benchmark comparability. Pace CRT mode switches. GAMESYNC re-copies Unreal.ini when its mtime moves, so the RefreshRate write must happen at every launch, like the viewport.
titles.verify_on_hw:
.124 (only with the V5 lane's agreement):
- Launch 'Play Unreal Gold.bat'.
- Unreal.log should read 'grSstOpen Res=7' (7 = GR_REFRESH_85Hz; the labels are swapped).
- The vcr-kmd flight recorder (EXEC C:\vcr\vcrctl.exe log > file, then DOWNLOAD) should show 'mode N: 1024x768x16@85' and 'pll ... refresh 85xxx mHz'.
- DISPLAYCFG get while running should read 1024x768 @85.
LCD boxes: DISPLAYCFG get while running should read 1920x1080 @60.
titles.verifier_notes: The D3DDrv path has no knob at all, so the LCD result rests only on 1080p being 60-only. .240's EDID was present at my 03:52 read (DELL E2313H) but absent at 00:10. If it drops again, GAMERES reports no rates, 0 means 'leave alone', and FLEETRES targets the persisted desktop.

titles.title: UnrealTournament
titles.engine_and_build: Unreal Engine 1, UT99 OldUnreal 469e (an SSE2 build with XP-only PEs). GameRenderDevice=D3D9Drv.D3D9RenderDevice, 469e's own Direct3D 9 renderer.
titles.on_boxes: Deployed on .123 .145 .195 .240. 'Play Unreal Tournament.bat' starts System\UnrealTournament.exe, and the ini reads GameRenderDevice=D3D9Drv on all four. .124: absent (DOWNLOAD error 3; gated because the Athlon XP 2400+ has no SSE2). UnrealTournament436 is the lane there. .243: gated (Win9x).
titles.resolution_per_box: 1920x1080x32 on .123/.145/.195/.240, written by the launcher and GAMERES as FullscreenViewportX/Y. The ini reads 1920x1080, and .145's UnrealTournament.log (2026-09-29 00:52) shows 469e running. .124/.243: n/a.
titles.refresh_control: [D3D9Drv.D3D9RenderDevice] RefreshRate=<Hz>, a UTF-16 property in D3D9Drv.dll. Above 0 it sets pp.FullScreen_RefreshRateInHz (prior disassembly at 0x100021a9 and 0x10002354). If CreateDevice fails, the renderer retries at the default and logs 'Failed to create D3D device with default refresh rate: %ls'. 469e's OpenGLDrv also has RefreshRate: when it is non-zero it adds DM_DISPLAYFREQUENCY (dmFields 0x580020).
titles.set_today: The staged constant RefreshRate=0, read back as 0 on all four, which means D3DPRESENT_RATE_DEFAULT. The launcher and GAMERES write only the viewport and StartupFullscreen.
titles.expected_today_per_box: 60 on all four. Inferred, not measured for this title: 60 is the only 1080p rate these panels list.
titles.gap: None on the connected boxes. It is right only because 1080p is 60-only.
titles.fix: Optional, for determinism: write RefreshRate=%HZW% into [D3D9Drv.D3D9RenderDevice] with a GR_OP_INI rule, and the same value from FR_HZW in the launcher's -ini block, once the per-target token lands. 0 means the default. On today's boxes this changes nothing.
titles.fix_risk: Low. The renderer itself falls back to the default rate if device creation fails.
titles.verify_on_hw: DISPLAYCFG get while in game should read 1920x1080 @60. Also check System\UnrealTournament.log for the D3D9 device creation.

titles.title: UnrealTournament436
titles.engine_and_build: Unreal Engine 1, UT99 retail 436. GameRenderDevice=OpenGLDrv.OpenGLRenderDevice (retail OpenGlDrv.dll md5 12031672) with FullscreenColorBits=16. GlideDrv is also present, with RefreshRate=60Hz.
titles.on_boxes: Deployed on .123 .124 .145 .195 .240. 'Play Unreal Tournament 436.bat' and 'Join fleet UT99 server - 436.bat' start System\UnrealTournament.exe. OpenGLDrv is the renderer on all five; no launcher writes a render device. On .124, opengl32 goes to the system ICD retroicd.dll (OpenGLDrivers\3dfx), which is our MesaFX running over our h5 glide3x. .124 also carries UnrealTournament.ini.v56kbak, left by the V5 benchmark lane. .243: gated (165 MHz CPU, needs 233), so its 'Voodoo' launcher (INI=Voodoo.ini, GlideDrv 640x480) is unused.
titles.refresh_control: None in OpenGlDrv (ChangeDisplaySettingsA with dmFields 0x180000 = PELSWIDTH|PELSHEIGHT, CDS_FULLSCREEN) or in D3DDrv (SetDisplayMode refresh 0). GlideDrv has the RefreshRate enum but is unused here. On .124 the effective control is Glide's FX_GLIDE_REFRESH. MesaFX already asks for the best rate, per retrogl.log on .124: 'fxBestRefresh: 1280x960 max 85 Hz -> GR_REFRESH enum 7'.
titles.expected_today_per_box: LCD boxes: 60, inferred. .124: 75, inferred from a pattern measured today on the same stack: the GDI set with no rate lands at 1280x960@60, then Glide re-sets the mode at the registry FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=75 (Quake II, GLQuake and HL, 03:55-03:59). UT436 itself was not measured.
titles.gap: .124: 75 Hz instead of 85. None on the LCD boxes.
titles.fix: .124 and any FR_GLIDE=1 box with an EDID: add 'if not defined FX_GLIDE_REFRESH set "FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=<best at FR_W x FR_H>"' before start in both 436 launchers. Alternatively, set it once in the generated FLEETRES.BAT when FR_GLIDE=1 and the per-target rate is non-zero; D3D and GDI paths never read the variable. LCD boxes need nothing.
titles.fix_risk: Low technically. UT436 is a V5 benchmark title on .124, so coordinate: the harness's own pinned FX_GLIDE_REFRESH must keep winning, which the 'if not defined' guard ensures. Apply CRT pacing.
titles.verify_on_hw: .124: after the GDI set, the vcr-kmd log should show 'mode N: 1280x960x16@85' (today it shows @75). Also check retrogl.log's fxBestRefresh line and DISPLAYCFG get while running. LCD boxes: DISPLAYCFG get should read 1920x1080 @60.

titles.title: UT2004
titles.engine_and_build: Unreal Engine 2, UT2004 ECE build 3369. RenderDevice=D3DDrv.D3DRenderDevice (Direct3D 8; D3DDrv.dll md5 b6bb4d87).
titles.on_boxes: Deployed on .123 .124 .145 .195 .240. 'Play UT2004.bat' and 'Join fleet UT2004 server.bat' start System\UT2004.exe, with D3DDrv on all five. On .124 the vcr-kmd DX7-level HAL cannot run it: UT2004.log (2026-09-28 07:13) reads 'Critical: CreateTexture failed(D3DERR_INVALIDCALL)'. .243: gated (no 3D).
titles.resolution_per_box: 1920x1080 on .123/.145/.195/.240 (ini read-back). 1280x960 on .124, where the log reads 'Enter SetRes: 1280x960 Fullscreen 1' with a 16-bit back buffer. .243: n/a.
titles.refresh_control: [D3DDrv.D3DRenderDevice] DesiredRefreshRate and OverrideDesktopRefreshRate (the same pair exists under [D3D9Drv.D3D9RenderDevice]). At 0x10011909, SetRes computes wanted = (DesiredRefreshRate > 60 || OverrideDesktopRefreshRate) ? DesiredRefreshRate : 0. The mode search keeps the minimum-error enumerated mode and, on ties, the one whose refresh equals wanted. pp.FullScreen_RefreshRateInHz is the matched mode's rate if wanted is set, else 0.
titles.set_today: The staged values DesiredRefreshRate=60 and OverrideDesktopRefreshRate=False, read back on all five, so wanted is 0 and the device uses D3DPRESENT_RATE_DEFAULT. gameres.h defines a %HZOVERRIDE% token for exactly this pair, but no rule uses it.
titles.expected_today_per_box: LCD boxes: 60, inferred. .124: the mode set landed at 85, measured in the vcr-kmd flight recorder on 2026-09-28 ('DrvEnablePDEV mode 90: 1280x960x16@85'), after which the game aborts.
titles.gap: None. On .124 the blocker is the renderer, not the refresh.
titles.fix: For determinism only: add GR_OP_INI rules DesiredRefreshRate=%HZW% and OverrideDesktopRefreshRate=%HZOVERRIDE% under [D3DDrv.D3DRenderDevice] (and D3D9Drv). Add matching FLEETRES -ini lines to both launchers from FR_HZW so the two writers agree.
titles.fix_risk: Low. The match loop accepts only enumerated modes, and at 1080p the wanted rate is 60, so nothing changes today.
titles.verify_on_hw: UT2004.log 'Best-match display mode: WxHxB@Hz' (it prints the enumerated mode's rate), plus DISPLAYCFG get while in game.

titles.title: DeusEx

titles.on_boxes: Deployed on .123 .124 .145 .195 .240. 'Play Deus Ex.bat' starts System\DeusEx.exe; 'Host Deus Ex Multiplayer.bat' is a headless server. D3DDrv on all five. On .124 it runs on the vcr-kmd D3D HAL: DeusEx.log (2026-09-29 00:07) reads 'szDriver=vcrdd.dll'. .243: gated (CPU).
titles.resolution_per_box: 1920x1080x32 on .123/.145/.195/.240 (ini read-back; the 1080p lane confirmed fullscreen). 1280x960x32 on .124: 'Best-match display mode: 1280x960x32 (Error=0)'. .243: n/a.
titles.refresh_control: None for D3DDrv: SetDisplayMode with refresh 0 (push 0/push 0 before the call at 0x1000b3bf), and no refresh string. The GlideDrv RefreshRate enum exists but is unused.
titles.set_today: Nothing. The staged [GlideDrv.GlideRenderDevice] RefreshRate=100Hz is an unused constant.
titles.expected_today_per_box: LCD boxes: 60, inferred. .124: 85, inferred from a measured class: every refresh-less DirectDraw/D3D exclusive set on vcr-kmd landed at 85 on 2026-09-28 (Thief Gold 640x480x16@85, Thief II 1280x960x32@85, Rainbow Six, UT2004), and a 640x480x16@85 set appeared again at 03:59 today. XP handed vcrdd a concrete 85. Deus Ex's own rate was not measured.

titles.fix_risk: n/a; no change is recommended today.

titles.title: Descent3
titles.engine_and_build: Descent 3 1.4.0 (the official no-CD file set; main.exe md5 61db25d7). Direct3D renderer: the registry has PreferredRenderer=3 on all five boxes.
titles.on_boxes: Deployed on .123 .124 .145 .195 .240. 'Play Descent 3.bat' (identical to the staged file, md5 3dd6cb02) and 'Join Descent 3 - LAN.bat' run main.exe -launched -Width FR_W -Height FR_H; 'Host' is the dedicated server. .243: gated (no 3D).
titles.resolution_per_box: Menus/UI at 640x480x16, measured today: .123 at 00:54 and .195 at 00:58 (DISPLAYCFG). In flight the display switches to FR_W x FR_H: 1920x1080x16 on the LCD boxes (1080p lane) and 1280x960 on .124. The view stays a 640x480 box until the 1080p lane's pilot-file fix lands.
titles.refresh_control: None. The D3D path calls IDirectDraw4::SetDisplayMode(w,h,bpp,refresh=ebx=0,flags=0) at 0x5354f0, and the 640x480x16 set at 0x535530. The OpenGL path's CDS uses dmFields 0x1c0000. A case-insensitive scan of main.exe finds no refresh switch.
titles.expected_today_per_box: In flight on the LCD boxes: 60, the only 1080p rate. Menus: MEASURED 640x480x16 @60 on .123, where 75 is listed, so the refresh-less DirectDraw set kept the desktop's 60. .195 also read @60, but it offers only 60. .124: 85, inferred from the DirectDraw class on vcr-kmd.
titles.fix: There is no title knob. Only a generic DirectDraw rate-filler can help: a game-local ddraw request-fixing shim (mechanism lane option e). DirectDraw\ForceRefreshRate cannot be used, because it is one rate for every size, and 75 would break the 60-only 1080p in-flight switch. refreshkeep must not run on an exclusive-DirectDraw title. Accepting 60 in the menus is reasonable.
titles.fix_risk: The shim is medium risk: a new, untested binary beside main.exe.
titles.verify_on_hw: DISPLAYCFG get at the main menu (640x480x16 @N) and again in flight (1920x1080x16 @N).

titles.title: SeriousSamFirstEncounter
titles.engine_and_build: Croteam Serious Engine 1, TFE retail v1.00 (Engine.dll build 10000.1, md5 6281c69e). OpenGL only: OPENGL32.DLL (ICD) or 3DFXVGL.DLL (3dfx MiniGL), chosen by sam_iDriver. There is no D3D8.
titles.on_boxes: Deployed on .123 .124 .145 .195 .240. The disc-mount Play, Host and Join launchers start Bin\SeriousSam.exe; Host also starts Bin\DedicatedServer.exe. On .195, PersistentSymbols.ini pins sam_iDriver=1, which the comment calls 'Direct3D' but which selects TFE's 3Dfx MiniGL. Its log shows '1920x1080xDesktop 3Dfx fullscreen' returning DISP_CHANGE_BADMODE for every mode, the ICD recovery modes included, then FatalError. On .124 the ICD is retroicd (MesaFX over our Glide). .243: gated.
titles.resolution_per_box: 1920x1080 on .123/.145/.240 via sam_iScreenSizeI/J; the .240 log reads 'CDS: mode set to 1920x1080x0' on a RADEON X800. .195: none, the game fails to set any mode. .124: 1280x960.
titles.refresh_control: gfx_iRefreshRate (Engine.dll: 'persistent user INDEX gfx_iRefreshRate;'). When it is above 0, the OpenGL CDS adds DM_DISPLAYFREQUENCY (dmFields 0x380000 becomes 0x780000). The same CDS also sets dmDisplayFlags=4, CDS_FULLSCREEN misused as a DEVMODE flag, together with DM_DISPLAYFLAGS.
titles.set_today: Yes. All three launchers write 'gfx_iRefreshRate=%FR_HZ%;' into Scripts\Game_startup.ini at every start, and the GAMERES 'ssam' body writes %FRHZ% at sync. Read back: 60 on the LCD boxes, 85 on .124. TFE accepts the line: no 'not declared' message appears in its logs.
titles.expected_today_per_box: XP LCD boxes: 60 (.240 log). .195: the game does not start. .124: 75, inferred. The CDS asks for 1280x960@85, then the MesaFX/Glide mode set applies FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=75. That pattern was measured today for ioquake3: 'mode 160: 1280x960x32@85', then 'mode 199: 1280x960x32@75'.
titles.gap: .124: 75 Hz instead of 85. On .195 the game does not start at all. That is not a refresh-rate gap, but the refresh line is the prime suspect for it.
titles.fix:
(1) .124: set FX_GLIDE_REFRESH per launch, as for Unreal Gold.
(2) .195: run a one-launch A/B with gfx_iRefreshRate=0 and sam_iDriver=0. The 1080p lane found that TFE 1.00 and TSE 1.05 share a byte-identical CDS routine (0x600faedd and 0x6003ad1d). Only TFE consumes the 60, and TSE sets 1920x1080 fine on .195 with no rate. If the A/B confirms it, have both writers emit 0 wherever the target lists only one rate.
(3) Later, move both writers from FR_HZ/FRHZ to the per-target token; the value is the same today.
titles.fix_risk: Low. The .195 cause is a hypothesis until the A/B runs. Keep both writers byte-identical (test_a_shared_cfg_is_written_identically_by_both_writers).
titles.verify_on_hw: SeriousSam.log: 'CDS: mode set to WxHx0' versus 'CDS error: DISP_CHANGE_BADMODE'. DISPLAYCFG get while running. On .124, the vcr-kmd log's final Glide mode line.
titles.verifier_notes: Correction to the shared brief: sam_iDriver=1 on .195 is not Direct3D in TFE, and TSE does not declare sam_iDriver at all ('not declared' in the TSE logs). The per-box renderer pin is therefore wrong in both titles.

titles.title: SeriousSamSecondEncounter
titles.engine_and_build: Serious Engine 1, TSE retail v1.05 (Engine.dll build 10000.5, md5 230c1b52). OpenGL and Direct3D 8, selected by sam_iGfxAPI.
titles.on_boxes: Deployed on .123 .124 .145 .195 .240. The disc-mount Play, Host and Join TSE launchers start Bin\SeriousSam.exe. The logs show OpenGL on .195 (HD 5450) and .240 (RADEON 9800 XT), and the 1080p lane saw OpenGL on .123. On .124 the default is OpenGL, through retroicd and Glide. .243: gated.
titles.resolution_per_box: 1920x1080 on the LCD boxes; the .195 and .240 logs read 'CDS: mode set to 1920x1080x0'. 1280x960 on .124.
titles.refresh_control: gap_iRefreshRate, NOT gfx_iRefreshRate. Engine.dll declares only 'persistent user INDEX gap_iRefreshRate;'. It is read by the OpenGL CDS (0x6003ad35, which adds DM_DISPLAYFREQUENCY) and by the D3D8 present parameters (0x6004c27a; 0 means D3DPRESENT_RATE_DEFAULT). Croteam's GPL source agrees.
titles.set_today: Broken. The launchers and GAMERES write 'gfx_iRefreshRate=<FRHZ>;', and the engine rejects it. MEASURED: 'Scripts\Game_startup.ini(7): Identifier 'gfx_iRefreshRate' is not declared' on .195, and the same at line 8 on .240. No refresh rate is set on any box. TSE does not declare 'sam_iDriver' either.
titles.expected_today_per_box: LCD boxes: 60, the only rate. .124, not measured: 75 if OpenGL (the CDS with no rate lands at 60, then Glide re-sets the mode at FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=75), or 85 if D3D8 (the DirectDraw class).
titles.gap: The refresh line is dead on every box. That costs nothing on the 60-only LCD boxes; on .124 the result is 75 or 85 instead of 85, depending on the API.
titles.fix:
Give TSE its own body:
- Split the gameres.h 'ssam' body into TFE and TSE versions; the TSE one writes 'gap_iRefreshRate=<per-target rate>;'.
- Make stage-fleetres.py ssam_startup_ini() take the variable name.
- Regenerate the three TSE launchers from provisioning/discmount/specs/SeriousSamSecondEncounter-*.json with make-mount-launcher.py.
- Split tests/native/test_gameres.c (line 579 pins 'gfx_iRefreshRate=85;') and the mirror tests per title.
Ship this with the 1080p lane's must-fix. Both writers currently overwrite TSE's four shipped Game_startup.ini lines, so the campaign cannot start. One option: both writers write Scripts\FleetRes.ini, and the staged Game_startup.ini includes it.
Emit 0 where the target lists only one rate. Do not emit a rate on Win7 .195 until an A/B proves it safe there (see TFE). On .124, add FX_GLIDE_REFRESH for the OpenGL path.
titles.fix_risk: Medium. A rate the adapter does not list makes the CDS fail, and the engine falls through its recovery modes to FatalError, as TFE does on .195. Use only enumerated per-target rates, and A/B on .195 first.
titles.verify_on_hw: SeriousSam.log must not contain "'gap_iRefreshRate' is not declared". In the SE console, type gap_iRefreshRate to read the value. Then DISPLAYCFG get while running.

titles.title: Halo
titles.engine_and_build: Halo: Combat Evolved PC 1.10, the Gearbox Direct3D 9 port (halo.exe md5 b7aa8f68, 2,822,144 B).
titles.on_boxes: Runnable on .123 .145 .195 .240. 'Play Halo.bat' runs halo.exe [-novideo] -vidmode FR_W,FR_H,FR_HZ. .123 carries the current 680-byte launcher (md5 e3f9bcbb). .145, .195 and .240 still carry an older 104-byte one (md5 ab92a422) with the same -vidmode line. .124 has a stale C:\Games\Halo, but the gate refuses the title there (the Athlon XP has no SSE2), so it cannot run. .243: gated.
titles.refresh_control: -vidmode w,h,r. The parser at 0x5168c0 reads it with sscanf '%d,%d,%d' (defaults 800x600@60), and the third field is the refresh. A separate '-refresh N' switch (string at 0x66ed70) writes the same variable. There is also the in-game rasterizer_refresh_rate. Disassembly in static/halo-vidmode-refresh-parser.disasm.txt.
titles.set_today: -vidmode 1920,1080,60. FR_HZ is FLEETRES's persisted desktop rate, which is 60 on all four boxes.
titles.expected_today_per_box: 60, the value passed and the only 1080p rate.
titles.gap: None. It is right only because the target equals the desktop mode: FR_HZ is the desktop's rate, not the best rate at FR_W x FR_H.
titles.fix: Once the mechanism lane lands, pass the per-target FR_HZW instead of FR_HZ, and omit the third field when it is 0. Unrelated to refresh: run GAMESYNC RESET+START on .145/.195/.240 so they get the current launcher.
titles.fix_risk: Low. An unlisted rate would fail D3D device creation, which FR_HZW rules out by construction.

titles.title: FarCry
titles.engine_and_build: CryEngine 1, Far Cry 1.4 (GOG 2.0.0.9). Direct3D 9 renderer Bin32\XRenderD3D9.dll (md5 85f9c71b).
titles.on_boxes: Deployed on .123 .145 .195 .240. 'Play Far Cry.bat' starts Bin32\FarCry.exe, and System.cfg has r_Driver="Direct3D9" on all four. .124: absent (gated: 32 MB VRAM, needs 64). .243: gated.
titles.resolution_per_box: 1920x1080x32 on .123/.145/.195/.240 (System.cfg r_Width/r_Height read back). The 1080p lane saw .145's log.txt read 'Current Resolution: 1920x1080x32 Full Screen'.
titles.refresh_control: None. No exe or dll in Bin32 has a refresh cvar, checked case-insensitively; only r_VSync, r_Width, r_FullScreen and r_Driver exist. XRenderD3D9 zeroes the chosen mode's RefreshRate at 0x38011592 before copying the mode into pp+0x30 (0x380532dd/0x380532e9), which gives D3DPRESENT_RATE_DEFAULT.
titles.fix: None needed. A panel with a higher 1080p rate would need a d3d9 request-fixing shim, or a same-size byte patch at 0x38011592, which is not recommended.
titles.verify_on_hw: DISPLAYCFG get while in game, and the mode lines in log.txt.

titles.title: Tribes2
titles.engine_and_build: Torque V12, Tribes 2 v25034.005 with TribesNext RC2a (GameData\Tribes2.exe md5 766bc1bd). OpenGL by default ($pref::Video::displayDevice="OpenGL" in scripts.vl2 clientDefaults.cs), with a D3D device through OpenGL2D3D.dll.
titles.on_boxes: Deployed on .123 .124 .145 .195 .240. 'Play Tribes 2 Online.bat' and 'Play Tribes 2 Solo and LAN.bat' run GameData\Tribes2.exe -mod Classic. Neither the tree nor either launcher has FLEETRES. On .124, OpenGL goes through retroicd and Glide. It has never run on any box: there is no ClientPrefs.cs anywhere (DOWNLOAD error 2 on all five). .243: absent.
titles.resolution_per_box: 800x600 on first start everywhere, per the 1080p lane: the engine default is 800x600x16 (0x5611f9), and the card profile then writes '800 600 32'. Not measured.
titles.refresh_control: None. OpenGLDevice::setScreenMode builds a DEVMODE with dmFields 0x1c0000 (no DM_DISPLAYFREQUENCY) and calls CDS_FULLSCREEN. There is no refresh pref; clientDefaults.cs sets only displayDevice, fullScreen, allow/preferOpenGL and disableVerticalSync.
titles.expected_today_per_box:
Not measured.
- .123/.145/.240: the driver default for a GDI set with no rate, probably 60. ForceWare 71.89 measured 60 on XP; ATI is unmeasured.
- .195: 60.
- .124: the GDI set lands at 60 (measured class), then Glide re-sets the mode at 75.
titles.gap: Probably 60 instead of 75 on .123/.145/.240, and 75 instead of 85 on .124. The LCD gap disappears once the game runs at 1920x1080.
titles.fix: Fix the resolution first (the 1080p lane's plan): stage FLEETRES and have both launchers write GameData\base\autoexec.cs at each launch with '$pref::Video::resolution = "%FR_W% %FR_H% 32";'. The game then runs at 1920x1080, which is 60-only, so the LCD boxes need no refresh work. On .124, set FX_GLIDE_REFRESH per launch. If a 4:3 size is ever kept, use refreshkeep (allowed for an OpenGL title), fed the per-target rate.
titles.fix_risk: Low. refreshkeep adds one extra monitor re-sync per mode set.
titles.verify_on_hw: DISPLAYCFG get once the main menu is up; on .124, the vcr-kmd log's final mode line.

titles.title: BF1942
titles.engine_and_build: Refractor 1, Battlefield 1942 v1.61b (BF1942.exe md5 a56d63e8, Direct3D 8). SafeDisc 2.80.010 sits in Mods\bf1942\Mod.dll.
titles.on_boxes: Deployed on .123 .124 .145 .195 .240. The disc-mount 'Play Battlefield 1942.bat' and the 'Join ... - LAN.bat' launcher start BF1942.exe; the 'Host' launcher starts BF1942_w32ded.exe, which has no display. The client never runs on this fleet: SafeDisc 2.80 is not satisfied, and the compat DB records runs=failed on .124, .240 and .195 (as .246), and n/a on .123. .243: gated.
titles.resolution_per_box: 1920x1080x32 on the LCD boxes and 1280x960x32 on .124, in both Profiles\Default and Profiles\Custom Video.con (read back). Moot while the client cannot start.
titles.refresh_control: The fourth argument of 'game.setGameDisplayMode W H BPP HZ'. The setter (0x6af100) ZEROES that value at call time unless renderer.allowAllRefreshRates is already 1. That flag lives at [renderer+0x2dd] and is set by 0x4440f0: on NT it takes the argument, on Windows 98/ME it is forced to 0. The value is meant for m_d3dpp.FullScreen_RefreshRateInHz (D3D8 present parameters at renderer+0xbc; the path from the stored value to the pp was not traced). Disassembly in static/bf1942-allowAllRefreshRates.disasm.txt.
titles.set_today: The fourth argument is 0 in both profiles, written by the launcher's -setline and by the gameres.h rule. allowAllRefreshRates appears only in Settings\VideoDefault.con, which nothing executes.
titles.expected_today_per_box: n/a: the client does not start. If it did: 60 on the LCD boxes and 85 on .124 (the D3D8 class).
titles.gap: None in effect; the problem is latent.
titles.fix:
(1) Stage 'renderer.allowAllRefreshRates 1' as the FIRST line of Profiles\Default\Video.con and Profiles\Custom\Video.con. FLEETRES -setline and GR_OP_SETLINE append a missing key at the END, which would run after setGameDisplayMode and too late to matter. Replacing the existing setGameDisplayMode line in place keeps the order.
(2) In both writers, write the fourth argument as %HZW%/FR_HZW, with 0 when unknown.
The in-game menu rewrites Custom\Video.con and drops the flag line, so the launcher must re-insert it, which needs a new insert-before op.
titles.fix_risk: Medium. A rate the adapter does not list at W x H makes D3D8 CreateDevice fail, so use only enumerated per-target rates. Latent until SafeDisc 2.80 is solved.
titles.verify_on_hw: Once the client runs: DISPLAYCFG get while in game.

titles.title: MaxPayne
titles.engine_and_build: MAX-FX, Max Payne retail v1.05. Direct3D 8 through e2driver\e2_d3d8_driver_mfc.dll (md5 a6efe0a1). MaxPayne.exe is wrapped in SafeDisc 2.51.020.
titles.on_boxes: Deployed on .123 .124 .145 .195 .240. The disc-mount 'Play Max Payne.bat' runs MaxPayne.exe -nodialog -skipstartup. The 1080p lane has never observed it rendering on a 1080p LCD. .243: gated.
titles.resolution_per_box: HKCU\Software\Remedy Entertainment\Max Payne\Video Settings Display Width/Height: 1920x1080 on .123/.145/.195/.240 and 1280x960 on .124 (read back).
titles.refresh_control: None found. The registry schema the game writes holds only Display Width, Display Height and Bits Per Pixel. The D3D8 driver maps REFRESHRATE_DEFAULT to 0 (at 0x100256c0) when filling pp.FullScreen_RefreshRateInHz ([esi+0x104]). MaxPayne.exe's own strings are SafeDisc-encrypted, so a hidden switch cannot be ruled out statically.
titles.expected_today_per_box: LCD boxes: 60, inferred. .124: 85, inferred from the D3D8 class (UT2004 measured at 85 on the same stack).
titles.fix: None needed. If a multi-rate target ever appears, a d3d8 request-fixing shim is the only lever.
titles.verify_on_hw: DISPLAYCFG get while in game. This needs SafeDisc 2.51 satisfied, i.e. DAEMON Tools 3.47 with emulation.

titles.title: RedFaction
titles.engine_and_build: Geo-Mod, Red Faction build 177 (rf.exe md5 0ba3b15d), Direct3D 8.
titles.on_boxes: Deployed on .123 .124 .145 .195 .240. The disc-mount 'Play Red Faction.bat' starts rf.exe. .243: gated.
titles.resolution_per_box: 640x480x16 on EVERY box today. The launcher and gameres.h write HKLM\SOFTWARE\Volition\Red Faction, which reads back 1920x1080 on the LCD boxes and 1280x960 on .124. rf.exe reads HKCU\Software\Volition\Red Faction instead, and on all five boxes that key holds only UpdateRate, ForcePort, StraightToSetup, Geometry Cache Size, Fast Animations and Vsync (read back today). The game therefore uses its default 640x480x16 (1080p lane).
titles.refresh_control: None. The D3D8 present parameters at 0x1cd42b0 are zeroed, and FullScreen_RefreshRateInHz (0x1cd42dc) has no writer. The registry value names are Resolution Width, Resolution Height, Resolution Bit Depth and Vsync.
titles.expected_today_per_box: .123/.145/.240: 60, inferred from the DirectDraw class measured on .123 (a refresh-less set keeps the desktop's 60 even where 75 is listed). .195: 60. .124: 85, inferred from the D3D class.
titles.gap: 60 instead of 75 at 640x480 on .123/.145/.240. This is a side effect of the wrong-hive resolution bug.
titles.fix: Fix the hive from HKLM to HKCU in the launcher spec's fleetres_block (provisioning/discmount/specs/RedFaction.json) and in gameres.h, then regenerate. The game then runs at 1920x1080, which is 60-only, so the LCD refresh gap disappears. No refresh knob exists.
titles.fix_risk: This is a resolution-lane change. The HUD is width-keyed (1080p lane finding).

titles.title: Turok2
titles.engine_and_build: Acclaim/Iguana Turok 2 (1998). Renderer Video_D3D.dll (md5 b3919d01), DirectDraw v1 plus D3D. Video_3DFx.dll (Glide) is present but unused.
titles.on_boxes: Deployed on .123 .124 .145 .195 .240. 'Play Turok 2 - Multiplayer.bat' starts Turok2MPEnglish.exe, and 'Join Turok 2 - LAN.bat' joins a LAN game. 'Play Turok 2.bat' starts Turok2English.exe, which needs the CD and is blocked on media. Every box's config.ned holds only VideoD3D keys, so the renderer is D3D. .243: gated.
titles.resolution_per_box: 1024x768x32 at launch on all five: the launchers' T2SEL ladder takes FR_W43=1280 to 1024^x^768 1. Between launches, the GAMERES %SEL43% rule zeroes all six modes (read back all 0 on all five), so the two writers fight. .243: n/a.
titles.refresh_control: None. The game calls IDirectDraw (v1) SetDisplayMode(this,w,h,bpp) at 0x10007b35; that interface has no refresh parameter. Video_3DFx.dll has a 'Refresh' option (60 to 120 Hz strings), but only for Glide.
titles.expected_today_per_box: .123/.145/.240: 60, inferred from the DirectDraw class measured on .123. .195: 60. .124: 85, inferred from the DirectDraw class on vcr-kmd.
titles.fix: There is no title knob on the D3D path. It needs a generic DirectDraw rate-filler, such as the mechanism lane's ddraw shim (option e). The alternative is DirectDraw\ForceRefreshRate set to the best rate at 1024x768 just before start and cleared on exit. The launcher would have to 'start /wait', and the value applies to every DirectDraw app while it is set. refreshkeep must not run on an exclusive-DirectDraw title. Separately, the GAMERES rule should use the launcher's ladder (resolution lane).
titles.fix_risk: ForceRefreshRate is machine-wide and unmeasured on these drivers. The shim is an untested binary.
titles.verify_on_hw: DISPLAYCFG get during a multiplayer game (expect 1024x768x32 @N).
titles.verifier_notes: The earlier survey said '.124 likely 60' for the DirectDraw/D3D titles (Turok 2, Deus Ex, Descent 3, Shogo, Max Payne, Red Faction). The vcr-kmd flight recorder refutes that. Refresh-less DirectDraw and D3D sets on .124 landed at 85 (2026-09-28, commit 6434268), and only GDI ChangeDisplaySettings with no rate lands at 60 (03:55-03:59 today). So the .124 gap is the Glide override, not the DirectDraw default.
